zh.title: 總統府啟動2026無人機競賽 排除紅色供應鏈產品
zh.summary: 總統府於2026年7月28日宣布啟動「總統盃2026無人機競賽」，以民主同盟及非紅供應鏈為主題。活動由經濟部、教育部及國科會共同辦理各項賽事，並由國科會、工研院與中科院建立審查機制，凡涉及紅色供應鏈之器材或產品均不具參賽資格。
body: 總統府於2026年7月28日召開新聞發布會，正式公布「總統盃2026無人機競賽」活動。總統府秘書長潘孟安表示，這次競賽以「民主同盟」及「非紅供應鏈」為主要主題，希望透過賽事培育科技應用人才。官方特別明確規範，凡涉及紅色供應鏈的器材或產品均不具備參賽資格，相關規則將載明於賽事規範中。
根據總統府說明，總統賴清德於2024年下半年指示希望透過無人機帶動國內產業發展，經跨部會整合與一年多籌備，參考美國 Green UAS（綠色無人機系統）標準，建構非紅無人機供應鏈。本次競賽由經濟部、國科會及教育部共同辦理，推動產、官、學、研共同參與。
在具體競賽項目方面，經濟部將辦理包括「無人機堆積木」、「無人機避障賽」以及「無人機精準投放」等障礙飛行挑戰賽。教育部則負責辦理「無人機足球競賽」，從小學階段開始推動無人機操作。國家科學及技術委員會則負責規劃辦理「關鍵技術挑戰賽」。
在賽事時程與地點安排上，經濟部主辦的競賽項目自2026年7月28日起開始受理報名，報名截止日期為8月31日，決賽預計於12月25在大台南會展中心舉辦。相關賽程與規範均已公布於各相關部會網站。
針對參賽設備的供應鏈檢核，國科會將聯合工業技術研究院及國家中山科學研究院共同建立檢核機制。經濟部產業發展署表示，非紅無人機審查流程分為三個階段，設備必須全面符合資格要求始准參賽。此外，活動現場亦規劃國防能量、應用服務、產業能量及學研成果等四項展示。

en.title: Taiwan Presidential Office Launches 2026 Drone Competition Excluding Red Supply Chain
en.summary: Taiwan's Presidential Office announced the launch of the Presidential Cup 2026 Drone Competition on July 28, 2026, focusing on the themes of democratic alliance and non-red supply chains. The competition will feature events organized by the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Education, and the National Science and Technology Council. Equipment or products linked to the red supply chain will be ineligible to participate. A verification mechanism involving three-stage reviews will be established by the National Science and Technology Council, the Industrial Technology Research Institute, and the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology to enforce compliance.
body: The Presidential Office of Taiwan announced the official launch of the Presidential Cup 2026 Drone Competition during a press conference on July 28, 2026. Secretary-General to the President Pan Men-an stated that the competition focuses on the themes of democratic alliance and non-red supply chains, aiming to cultivate technology application talent. Official rules explicitly state that any equipment or products linked to the red supply chain are disqualified from participating in the event.

According to the Presidential Office, President Lai Ching-te instructed in the second half of 2024 to utilize drones to drive domestic industry growth. Following more than a year of cross-departmental coordination, the project referenced the United States Green UAS (Green Unmanned Aircraft Systems) standards to construct a non-red drone supply chain, encouraging joint participation across industry, government, academia, and research sectors.

Regarding specific competition categories, the Ministry of Economic Affairs will organize obstacle flight challenges, including drone block stacking, drone obstacle avoidance, and drone precision dropping. The Ministry of Education will host drone soccer competitions to promote drone operation beginning at the elementary school level, while the National Science and Technology Council will plan a key technology challenge.

For competition schedules, registration for the events hosted by the Ministry of Economic Affairs opened on July 28, 2026, and will remain open through August 31. The final rounds are scheduled to take place on December 25 at the International Convention Center Tainan. Detailed contest schedules and regulations have been published on the respective websites of the participating government agencies.

To ensure supply chain compliance for participating equipment, a dedicated verification mechanism will be jointly established by the National Science and Technology Council, the Industrial Technology Research Institute, and the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology. The Administration of Industrial Development under the Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that verification involves a three-stage review process. Additionally, the event will feature four major exhibition areas covering defense capabilities, application services, industrial capacity, and academic-research achievements.
